title: 55th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/55/2024).
Approval of the minutes of two previous sittings (minutes Nos. 49/2024 and 50/2024).

Question by Velidhoo MP Mohamed Abbas to the Minister of Construction and Infrastructure, Dr Abdulla Muththalib: since the previous government awarded the N. Fodhdhoo harbour project to MTCC, when will physical work begin, and what is its current status?

Question by Velidhoo MP Mohamed Abbas to the Minister of Construction and Infrastructure, Dr Abdulla Muththalib: the N. Velidhoo harbour development stalled after work began; when will it be completed so residents and visitors can use a modern harbour?
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Bill to amend the Sports Act (Law No. 30/2015), submitted on behalf of the government by Dhidhdhoo MP Abdul Latheef Mohamed.
Continued debate on the Budget Committee's report on the proposed State Budget for 2025.
Report of the joint committee of the National Development and Heritage Committee and the Decentralisation Committee on its review of the Urban Development Bill.
Public Finance Committee report on its review of the Public Debt Bill.
Public Finance Committee report on its review of the Fiscal Responsibility Bill.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to approve old minutes, put two harbour questions to the Infrastructure Minister, continue the Sports Act amendment, and debate committee reports on the 2025 State Budget, the Urban Development Bill, the Public Debt Bill and the Fiscal Responsibility Bill.
